title: Legacy Compose build does not enable BuildKit
symptom: The ARM64 backend image build reaches uv sync and stops with 'the --mount option requires BuildKit'.
reproduction_steps: Start Colima with Docker proxy configured
Run the project Compose build using the installed docker-compose command
Observe backend Dockerfile step RUN --mount=type=cache fail
hypothesis: The installed legacy docker-compose invocation uses the classic builder unless DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 is exported or the Dockerfile cache mount is removed.

title: Validation caches appeared outside literal scope globs
symptom: Scope guard reported root .mypy_cache/** and .ruff_cache/** as out of scope.
reproduction_steps: Run the T-006 scope guard check
hypothesis: Static-analysis commands created normal ignored cache files at repository root.

reason: Both directories are expected tool caches, are ignored by repository .gitignore, do not appear in Git status, and contain no product or user data. No source-scope expansion is needed.
The backend Dockerfile no longer uses a BuildKit-only cache mount; the classic builder completed the current image build and the README one-command container test passed.

evidence: git status contains only .ai governance files after implementation and documentation commits
